First the game is fine but not great. It only earns a two star because of some things. They made some cool cosmetics but you can steal them easily. I stole almost the whole store. I do think they are trying to fix it. A not so great look on the game is the fact that they stole the Capuchin face model, and also stole the Gorilla Tag skybox. It is a brand new game so it kind of forgivable. They hands are weird and when holding your real hand out normally your hands in the game are vertical. Why give it a two star though? Well, the map is cool and original, despite it being SUPER easy to get out of it and unload everything. That is about it for this game. They will most likely improve in the future. The game is also pretty boring too :/

developer_response.body:
Hey! I would like to address some of the issues you mentioned in your review!

First the shoplifting issue: The shoplifting issue was an error that unfortunately was not caught during testing. We have fixed the shoplifting issue. The fix is included in the new update coming out today!

Regarding the face and skybox textures: The face and skybox textures are assets that can be found online including on Google. We understand your concerns. The face and skybox textures were not stolen from another game.

The hands: The hands are currently being improved. We are looking into hand models to make the hands look more realistic and feel better in-game .

The unloading issue: The unloading issue is also being investigated. We are working on the unloading issue to improve the experience.

regarding the game being "boring”: The game was launched a few days ago and we are actively adding more content, features and things to do with every update. The game has a lot planned for the future.

Thanks, for taking the time to leave a review and share your feedback! We really appreciate the review. We hope this helps clarify the issues you mentioned. We hope you will consider updating your review as we continue to improve the game! ❤️

— The SimionVR Team
